title: Hanasato Minori — Chasing My Seniors〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: The Warmth of a Guiding Hand

rows.Line: Ryusuiso - Peony Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We're going home today...
Time sure flew by...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It really did. The hot spring was really refreshing, the food was delicious... It's such a shame that we have to leave.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But there's still breakfast, so let's try to enjoy every second we have left here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait, that reminds me...
It's actually almost time for breakfast. We need to move all the bedding and our stuff off to the side.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's do that...

rows.Speaker: Proprietress's Voice
rows.Line:
Good morning.
Would now be a good time for us to start serving you breakfast?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! Talk about perfect timing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Everything's cleared away...
Yes, please. That would be excellent.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: Pardon the intrusion.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow! It already smells amazing!
What do you think they're serving?

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll bring each item to you one at a time, if you don't mind giving us a moment.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Salt-baked salmon! One of my favorites! Hehe. I'm so happy!

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: Ah, Ms. Hanasato, I didn't realize that you were the salmon connoisseur I heard about.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: Ayaka told me that one of you likes salmon very much and would really enjoy it if we served some.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: So, I decided to serve the largest salmon we had. I'll place it right here in front of you, Ms. Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Thank you! I don't know what to say!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Saito remembered what my favorite food was...!)

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: There we are... Now, ladies, please take your time and enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! Let's dig in!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm so happy for you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! This salmon's one thing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I think I'm even happier about Saito remembering my favorite food!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You are?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I've been noticing lately that our fans are starting to remember some of the things I've been saying on our streams. Like my favorite snacks and the cosmetics I use, you know?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Some have been posting about it on social media. One person said, “I use the same cosmetics!” and another said, “I went out and bought some of those snacks you recommended, Minori.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Someone even wrote a letter to me saying how they're going to buy from the same brand as me the next time they go shopping.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Reading things like that really makes it feel like people are starting to know who I am.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I feel so happy knowing that I've grown as an idol!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I remember feeling the same thing when I was still in ASRUN. When I read things like that that fans had said, it made me realize how much they supported me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Of course, the fans who've been longtime supporters are all very important.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we need to do our best to keep showing the newcomers all new sides of us. Which means we gotta keep growing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She's right. I can't be happy with where I am currently...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The others all have more experience than me and have fans who've been supporting them for a really long time...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And they're still doing their best for them.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I have the least experience out of all of us, so I shouldn't be letting my guard down! That means I need to try even harder and harder and harder!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna power up by eating as much as I can!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What are you talking about all of a sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In any case, this is a perfect power breakfast. Salmon is packed with the protein that you need for strength training.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Then I should also eat up and try to get the most out of this meal.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. But I'm gonna eat much more than you!
